Proposed ABA signaling pathway regulation based on GRN and WGCNA results from rapeseed RNA-Seq meta-analysis

Proposed ABA signaling pathway regulation based on GRN and WGCNA results from rapeseed RNA-Seq meta-analysis. (a) The central black circle depicts the core ABA signaling pathway. Node-edge color scheme: green = upregulated components, red = downregulated components. Node shapes: circles = genes, rectangles = transcription factors. Edge terminators: arrows = activation, circles = inhibition. Both direct and indirect interactions (via other regulators) are possible between BHLH128-1 and ABI5. (b) Interactions between BHLH128 and ABI5 in Arabidopsis, including intermediate nodes inferred from the STRING database
